quote: AlphaEvolve became generally available on Google Cloud on July 9, 2026.
note: AlphaEvolve is an agent orchestration system (not a standalone model) that uses Gemini LLMs with evolutionary algorithms to design advanced algorithms. First announced in private preview on May 14, 2025, then reached general availability on Google Cloud on July 9, 2026.
queries: AlphaEvolve May 2025 announcement Google DeepMind public release
